records.source: Dammit... I almost forgot. I have to go see Doctor Harvey today.
records.translation: Lintik... Muntik ko nang makalimutan. Kailangan kong magpatingin kay Doktor Harvey ngayon.

records.source: What are you doing in here? I could've been naked!$a
records.translation: Ano ang ginagawa mo rito? Baka nakahubad ako!$a

records.source: I feel more relaxed at night... I might even buy a trinket.
records.translation: Mas panatag ako sa gabi... Baka bumili pa nga ako ng Munting Palamuti.

records.source: Don't worry, this is only Joja Cola.
records.translation: Huwag kang mag-alala, Joja Cola lang ito.

records.source: Hmm... I have to say, JojaMart has a much better selection of frozen dinners.
records.translation: Hmm... Aaminin ko, mas maganda ang mapagpipiliang nagyelong handang pagkain sa JojaMart.

records.source: If I don't order a cold one now and then, Gus will go out of business. I'm just doing my civic duty. I'll head home around 10.
records.translation: Kung hindi ako oorder ng malamig na serbesa paminsan-minsan, malulugi si Gus. Ginagampanan ko lang ang tungkulin ko bilang mamamayan. Uuwi ako bandang 10.

records.source: I'll just play one more round...$h
records.translation: Isa pang laro lang...$h

records.source: Oh, hey @. Miss me already?$6
records.translation: Ah, uy, @. Hinahanap mo na agad ako?$6

records.source: I'm attached to these woods... lots of memories...
records.translation: Malapit sa puso ko ang gubat na ito... napakaraming alaala...

records.source: It smells bad in here.
records.translation: Mabaho rito.

records.source: I've got cola block... do I pick Joja Classic or Joja Bluu? I might be here a while...
records.translation: Nablangko ako sa cola... Joja Classic ba o Joja Bluu ang pipiliin ko? Baka matagalan ako rito...

records.source: I'm taking a night off from the saloon for Jas' sake...
records.translation: Hindi muna ako pupunta sa saloon ngayong gabi para kay Jas...

records.source: *sob*... I have to get my shots today.$s
records.translation: *hikbi*... Kailangan kong magpaturok ngayon.$s

records.source: *gulp*... Mommy, don't make me do it.$s
records.translation: *lunok*... Mama, huwag mo akong pilitin.$s

records.source: Do I get a lollipop for being so brave?
records.translation: Makakakuha ba ako ng lollipop dahil napakatapang ko?

records.source: I wanna ride the boat!!
records.translation: Gusto kong sumakay sa bangka!!

records.source: Handling salty fish all day makes me real thirsty.
records.translation: Nauuhaw talaga ako sa buong araw na paghawak ng maalat na isda.

records.source: Ah... Nothing's better than kicking back with a cold one after a relaxing day fishing.$h
records.translation: Ah... Walang tatalo sa pagpapahinga kasama ang malamig na serbesa matapos ang payapang araw ng pangingisda.$h

records.source: I have a doctor's appointment today, so if you need to buy anything you'd better hurry.
records.translation: May takdang pagpapatingin ako sa doktor ngayon, kaya magmadali ka kung may kailangan kang bilhin.

records.source: Eh, I got a fish hook stuck in my thumb... the Doctor's gonna cut it out.
records.translation: Ah, bumaon sa hinlalaki ko ang kawit... Aalisin iyon ng Doktor.

records.source: Yowch! That hurt, Doc!$s
records.translation: Aray! Masakit iyon, Dok!$s

records.source: I need a little warm-me-up to be ready for another cold night on the ocean.$h
records.translation: Kailangan ko ng kaunting pampainit upang maging handa sa isa na namang malamig na gabi sa karagatan.$h

records.source: I need a little warm-me-up to be ready for another cold night on the ocean.$h
records.translation: Kailangan ko ng kaunting pampainit upang maging handa sa isa na namang malamig na gabi sa karagatan.$h

records.source: I can't get me a good night's sleep with that night market going on... eh, but that's okay. I'm flexible.
records.translation: Hindi ako makatulog nang mahimbing dahil sa pamilihang panggabi... ah, pero ayos lang. Marunong akong umangkop.

records.source: Have you been on the deep-sea submarine? The captain's an old friend.
records.translation: Nakasakay ka na ba sa submarino sa malalim na dagat? Matagal ko nang kaibigan ang kapitan.

records.source: Ah, nothin' like a hot beverage to wind down after a cold, dark day...
records.translation: Ah, walang tatalo sa mainit na inumin upang magpahinga matapos ang malamig at madilim na araw...

records.source: I saw a big mango floating in the sky. Linus told me it was a hot-air balloon!$u#$b#I thought only birds could fly...
records.translation: May nakita akong malaking mangga na lumulutang sa langit. Sabi ni Linus, lobo raw iyon ng mainit na hangin!$u#$b#Akala ko mga ibon lang ang nakalilipad...

records.source: When I first arrived, Linus made me a suit out of leaves, like his...#$b#But I looked funny... like a fuzzy mango!$h#$e#I think I'll stick to my feathers.
records.translation: Noong una akong dumating, ginawan ako ni Linus ng kasuotang yari sa mga dahon, gaya ng sa kaniya...#$b#Pero nakakatawa ang hitsura ko... parang mabalahibong mangga!$h#$e#Sa tingin ko, mananatili ako sa mga balahibo ko.

records.source: I need to find some place to live...$s#$b#But I have a plan... I'm going to rely on my friends.
records.translation: Kailangan kong humanap ng matitirhan...$s#$b#Pero may plano ako... Aasa ako sa mga kaibigan ko.

records.source: Wow, tastes just like golden walnuts! This is great!
records.translation: Wow, lasang-lasang Ginintuang Walnut! Napakasarap nito!

records.source: I like this weather... it's so humid. It reminds me of the forest back home.
records.translation: Gusto ko ang panahong ito... napakahumid. Ipinapaalala nito sa akin ang gubat sa dating tahanan ko.

records.source: It felt bad at first... to leave the island and set foot in a strange land.$s#$e#But, I got used to it after a while.#$b#I'm a very flexible person!$h
records.translation: Masama sa pakiramdam noong una... ang iwan ang isla at tumapak sa di-kilalang lupain.$s#$e#Pero nasanay din ako kalaunan.#$b#Napakadali kong umangkop!$h

records.source: I felt like a stranger here, at first. But I've made a lot of friends!$h#$b#For once, I feel like I belong...
records.translation: Pakiramdam ko ay estranghero ako rito noong una. Pero marami na akong naging kaibigan!$h#$b#Sa wakas, pakiramdam ko ay kabilang ako rito...

records.source: Miss Penny is doing her best to get me up to speed in my schooling. She's really nice...#$e#...Luckily, I remember some things from my old, old life... before washing up on the island... so it's not as difficult as it could be.#$e#Miss Penny says she's impressed with how much I know!
records.translation: Ginagawa ni Binibining Penny ang lahat upang makahabol ako sa pag-aaral. Napakabait niya...#$e#...Mabuti na lang at may ilang bagay akong naaalala mula sa dati kong buhay noong napakatagal na panahon... bago ako napadpad sa isla... kaya hindi ito kasinghirap sana.#$e#Sabi ni Binibining Penny, hanga siya sa dami ng alam ko!

records.source: I'm sure Jas and Vincent thought I was weird, at first. I accidentally squawked at the school table a few times... that didn't help.$s#$e#It was a big change for everyone. But we're good friends now!$h
records.translation: Tiyak na inakala nina Jas at Vincent na kakaiba ako noong una. Hindi ko sinasadyang mapakiyaw na parang loro sa mesa ng paaralan nang ilang beses... hindi iyon nakatulong.$s#$e#Malaking pagbabago iyon para sa lahat. Pero mabubuti na kaming magkaibigan ngayon!$h

records.source: Between Linus and Miss Penny, I'm going to learn everything there is to learn!$h#$e#Mayor Lewis says I'm on the fast track to becoming a 'well-rounded citizen'... whatever that means.
records.translation: Sa tulong nina Linus at Binibining Penny, matututuhan ko ang lahat ng maaaring matutuhan!$h#$e#Sabi ni Mayor Lewis, mabilis daw akong patungo sa pagiging “ganap na mamamayan”... anuman ang ibig sabihin niyon.

records.source: Have you ever noticed all the interesting birds that live here?#$e#If you listen closely, they might tell you something.
records.translation: Napansin mo na ba ang lahat ng kawili-wiling ibong naninirahan dito?#$e#Kung makikinig kang mabuti, baka may sabihin sila sa iyo.

records.source: The birds of this valley don't mind the cold so much.#$e#I'm a little jealous of their warm coats...$s
records.translation: Hindi gaanong iniinda ng mga ibon sa lambak na ito ang lamig.#$e#Medyo naiinggit ako sa maiinit nilang balahibo...$s

records.source: Linus has been teaching me about all the wild food in the valley. There's a lot of good stuff out here!$h#$e#Though... I do kind of miss having golden walnuts for breakfast every morning...$s
records.translation: Tinuturuan ako ni Linus tungkol sa lahat ng ligaw na pagkaing matatagpuan sa lambak. Maraming masarap dito!$h#$e#Pero... medyo nami-miss ko ang pagkain ng Ginintuang Walnut tuwing almusal...$s

records.source: Linus taught me how to make a special spice berry rubbed fish...#$b#He says if I eat enough of it it'll keep me warm this winter!$h
records.translation: Tinuruan ako ni Linus na gumawa ng espesyal na isdang pinahiran ng Mabangong Bunga...#$b#Sabi niya, kung kakain ako nang sapat nito, mananatili akong mainit ngayong taglamig!$h

records.source: Uncle Linus says I should 'cook' my fish before eating it...$s#$b#I'm having a hard time getting used to it... so dry...$s
records.translation: Sabi ni Tito Linus, dapat kong “lutuin” ang isda ko bago kainin...$s#$b#Nahihirapan akong masanay rito... napakatuyo...$s

records.source: Hey, @. Nice to see you back on the island, just like old times. This is fun!#$e#You know, I was scared when you first arrived... I knew my life was about to change.$u
records.translation: Uy, @. Masayang makita kang bumalik sa isla, gaya noong dati. Nakakatuwa ito!#$e#Alam mo, natakot ako noong una kang dumating... Alam kong magbabago na ang buhay ko.$u

records.source: You know, Stardew Valley might be my new home... but the island will always be my home, too.#$e#It's nice to be able to come back and visit.
records.translation: Alam mo, maaaring bagong tahanan ko ang Stardew Valley... pero palagi ko ring magiging tahanan ang isla.#$e#Masarap makabalik at makadalaw.

records.source: Maybe some day, I'll visit Zuzu City...$u#$b#But I'm not even close to being ready, yet. This world is already so strange to me, and I'm very comfortable here right now!$h
records.translation: Baka balang araw, bibisitahin ko ang Lungsod ng Zuzu...$u#$b#Pero malayong-malayo pa ako sa pagiging handa. Kakaiba na para sa akin ang mundong ito, at komportableng-komportable ako rito ngayon!$h

records.source: The parrots want me to thank you for all the golden walnuts you've found. They're really enjoying them.$h
records.translation: Gusto ng mga loro na pasalamatan kita sa lahat ng Ginintuang Walnut na nahanap mo. Tuwang-tuwa silang kainin ang mga iyon.$h

records.source: @? Um... I'm a little embarrassed to ask...$u#$b#But... do you think Jas would ever like a guy like me?$u#$b#Or am I too weird?$s#$e#Hahaha... who cares. I'll figure it out some day.$h
records.translation: @? Um... Medyo nahihiya akong magtanong...$u#$b#Pero... sa tingin mo ba magugustuhan ni Jas ang isang lalaking tulad ko?$u#$b#O masyado ba akong kakaiba?$s#$e#Hahaha... wala akong pakialam. Malalaman ko rin balang araw.$h
